(1) The two numbers disagree because the progress counts required items only (ruling on #32643) while "show completed (N)" counts every completed row, optional ones included; on the hosted profile, mail and first record are optional, which gives 6/7 against 8. (2) Three lines say "Setup" in English in every language. (3) With two items or fewer left, the top placement still draws the full card.
Basis: card #35417, a p2 child of epic #34571, which the maintainer handed to this seat on 2026-11-21 03:24:57Z (「34571 专题你也接手」).
Scope: the progress stays required-only (the #32643 ruling is not reopened); the collapsed row names the split, for example "(required 6 · optional 2)", and stays "(6)" when no optional item is done. Each language uses the Setup app's own translated name (German keeps "Setup"). With two items or fewer left, the top placement folds into one line: title, progress, the remaining items' names, a "set up" button per item, and close; "set up" expands the card and opens that item. The phone placement (already one line) and the list of items do not change.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold (#35418, the approval timeline, shares no file). The PR carries `Fixes #35417`. The branch is the area thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.
